metadata.title: fix: update assertions for blocklist activity checks in idle timeout tests
metadata.author: Lang-Akshay

description:
## Summary

- Replace `assert_called_once_with` / `assert_called_once` with `assert_any_call` / `assert mock.called` in `test_auth_idle_timeout.py`
- Fixes 6 failing assertions that broke when middleware began invoking blocklist methods multiple times per request (e.g. auth middleware + logout handler both calling `get_last_activity`/`update_activity`)
- No production code changed; test-only fix

## Changed file

`tests/unit/mcpgateway/test_auth_idle_timeout.py`
